answers.core: This is core functionality that should work properly out of the box by default.
answers.workaround: It takes more than just a few lines of code to work around this *correctly*. You can set buttons to release mode and check for `ui_confirm` inputs manually, but doing so is prone to bugs in handling focus and input repetition, and avoiding them adds length.
